_comment: Earth-shaped continents (docs/earth-continents.md). Europe and Asia keep their region ids and ports and only change their maps, as fresh worlds. Africa takes the place of the desert and jungle regions: remove those two entries and add this one on a free port. Oceania, Greenland and Antarctica are new lands reached by sea and air; pick free ports for them. The ids are fixed: Europe's east edge and Africa's north-east edge lead to asia, and Asia's west edge to europe and africa.
